Israeli Parliament Elects Opposition-Backed Speaker

Israel's parliament, the Knesset, has elected Matan Kahana, an ally of Benny Gantz's National Unity party, as its new speaker. Kahana secured the position with support from the opposition bloc. This development is seen as a significant setback for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's Likud party, which had backed a different candidate. The vote for speaker had faced potential delays due to concerns from the Eisenkot bloc about a Likud-backed filibuster. The election of Kahana places a powerful role in the hands of the opposition.
